name: DropAlertz Studio AI for WooCommerce
author: dropalertz

sections.description:
DropAlertz Studio AI is a powerful AI creative photography studio built specifically for WooCommerce stores. Transform basic smartphone snapshots into high-end advertising content ready for your store catalog and social channels.

Key Highlights

  • 100% Product Geometry Guarantee: Advanced isolation pipeline preserves your exact product silhouette, fine typography, stitch patterns, seams, and brand logos with zero deformation or warping.
  • 450+ Studio Environments: Curated commercial lighting sets across 15 high-converting industries (Streetwear, Luxury & Jewelry, Cosmetics & Skincare, Beverages, Automotive, Home, Pets, and more).
  • Hyper-Realistic AI Models: Showcase your apparel, sunglasses, jewelry, and footwear on diverse fashion models with authentic studio lighting.
  • Cinematic Video Ads: Produce high-converting 9:16 vertical reels and 4:5 social feeds with smooth camera sweeps, atmospheric vapor, and lighting transitions.
  • WordPress Media Library & Gallery Integration: Sync and import high-resolution generated renders directly into your WordPress media library and WooCommerce product galleries.
  • Native WooCommerce Integration: Browse your store catalog directly from the admin panel and launch creative sessions with 1 click.

Pricing & Free Trial

DropAlertz Studio AI provides 10 Free Welcome Credits upon activation so you can immediately experience professional studio rendering without any upfront cost or required credit card. Additional credits or monthly top-up packs can be purchased as needed.

External Services

This plugin connects to external web services provided by DropAlertz (https://dropalertz.com) to provide AI image processing, background rendering, product isolation, and cinematic video synthesis.

  • What service is used: The DropAlertz Cloud Rendering API and Studio Web Application.
  • Why it is used: Generating photorealistic AI backgrounds and video rendering requires high-performance cloud GPU clusters that cannot be executed on local WordPress hosting servers.
  • What data is sent: Product image URLs, product titles, and user-selected studio lighting prompts. No customer personal data, passwords, or order payment details are ever transmitted.
  • When data is sent: Data is sent only when an administrator clicks to open the studio or initiates an image rendering/sync action.
  • Terms of Service: https://dropalertz.com/legal/terms.html
  • Privacy Policy: https://dropalertz.com/legal/privacy.html
sections.installation:
1. Upload the dropalertz-studio-ai folder to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install directly through the WordPress Plugins dashboard.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to WooCommerce > DropAlertz Studio AI in your admin dashboard.
  4. Select any product from your catalog and launch the studio session.
sections.faq:
Does DropAlertz Studio AI modify my original product images?

No. Your original WooCommerce photos remain 100% untouched. Generated photos are rendered in ultra-high resolution and you can choose whether to append them to your product gallery.

Does it distort logos, text, or small details?

DropAlertz Studio AI features a dedicated Geometry Guarantee engine that isolates and protects your product silhouette, labels, and text, modifying only the background environment and studio lighting.

Which formats and resolutions are supported?

Outputs are available in HD 1080p and Ultra 4K Studio Master, formatted in 1:1 Square (Product Grid), 4:5 Portrait (Feed & Mobile), and 9:16 Vertical (Stories, Reels & Video Ads).
